description:
Redeem 1.0 | 20'' Kids' BMX Bike

Hi-ten Steel Frame - Sturdy and durable.
Wide 20 x 2.35" Tires & Double U-brake - Ensure your kid's safety.
360 ° Rotor & 4 Pegs - Increase the way of riding and have fun.

Designed for versatility and performance, Hiland gives you a comfortable and affordable bike for riding!

Sturdy and Comfortable

Hiland BMX bikes for kids are built to last with a rugged hi-ten steel frame and components.

High density foam padding makes the seat more comfortable for your kids.

Excellent Safety

Wide 20 x 2.35 inch tires which is thicker than other kid's bikes, have a great grip even on uneven roads.

Equips with non-slip double U-brake system, which makes your kids safer when doing 360-degree performance.

Professional Functionality

The handlebar and fork are joined by a stem, 360 ° rotor allow you to turn the handlebar completely.

Plus, 4 pegs allow kids to try hops and tricks easily, which makes the riding more entertaining.

Assembly & Guide

85% pre-assembled, free pedals and required assembly tools included, easy to assemble.
* Since BMX is 360-degree rotation, it has different brake design.

Please watch the brake assemble video carefully after receiving the bike to get good braking effect and safety, also you can adjust the brake cable to prevent too tight or too loose.

Solutions will be quickly provided by support team within 24 hours! Bikes all have been inspected before package. Solve all your worries!

U-Brake

Consist of professional BMX U-brake system, which makes your kids safer when doing 360-degree performance.

Wide Tire

Wide 20’’*2.35" tires have a great grip and add more stability.

360° Rotor

360 ° rotor allows riders to turn the handlebar completely which makes the riding more entertaining.

4 Pegs

4 pegs in the front and back allow kids to try hops and tricks easily.

Master the basics with the Hiland Redeem 1.0 20-Inch BMX Bike. Featuring a high-strength steel frame, 360° gyro rotor for barspins, and 4 pegs. The perfect entry-level freestyle bike for kids and teens.
